title: Missing data and nullable dtypes
summary: Distinguish missing values from valid zeros, empty strings and false values.

blocks.text: Distinguish missing values from valid zeros, empty strings and false values.

items: Prefer nullable integer/string/boolean dtypes when missing values are valid.
Fillna should encode a real business assumption, not merely silence an error.
Convert dates and numerics with explicit error handling during ingestion.

blocks.title: Example
blocks.explanation: Unparsable values become NaN and then <NA> in the nullable Int64 column. The cast fails if a coerced value has a fractional part (for example "2.5"), so validate or round explicitly first. Not executed during preparation.
